title: PHEV
sources:
- [Edmunds 2025 Escape PHEV](https://www.edmunds.com/ford/escape/2025/plug-in-hybrid/)
- [Consumer Reports Escape PHEV road test](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/ford/escape-plug-in-hybrid/2025/road-test-report/)
- [Bill Brown 2025 PHEV specs](https://www.billbrownford.net/ford-escape/2025-escape-plug-in-hybrid-specs/)
- [US News 2025 Escape PHEV](https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/ford/escape-plug-in-hybrid)
adasStandard: Co-Pilot360 2.0 + Co-Pilot360 Assist+ (ACC + lane centering + evasive steering) standard. Source: [Ford.com Escape PHEV](https://www.ford.com/suvs-crossovers/escape/), [Edmunds 2025 PHEV](https://www.edmunds.com/ford/escape/2025/plug-in-hybrid/).
adasOptional: Active Park Assist 2.0 available. No BlueCruise. Source: Ford BlueCruise availability.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard with dynamic guidelines + HD. Source: Ford.com.
sideViewCameraNotes: 360 surround-view standard on Escape PHEV. Source: Edmunds.
subscriptionFeatures: FordPass Connect (limited free trial), SiriusXM. Charge scheduling free via FordPass app. Source: Ford.
drmNotes: Core offline. FordPass Connect modem for OTA, remote start, charge scheduling via FordPass app. Source: Ford.com.
killSwitchNotes: No BlueCruise; no separate impaired-driving kill switch. Source: Ford BlueCruise availability.
knownIssues: Earlier MY Escape PHEVs (2020-2022) were subject to a battery-pack fire-risk recall (NHTSA 22V-462) and a stop-sale period. MY2025 carries forward post-fix. Charging port latches reported as occasionally finicky. Source: [NHTSA recall 22V-462](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls), [Consumer Reports Escape PHEV](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/ford/escape-plug-in-hybrid/2025/road-test-report/).
recalls: Prior NHTSA 22V-462 (battery pack fire risk, fixed); ongoing minor electrical service bulletins. Source: NHTSA.
stateIncentives: Escape PHEV may qualify for state PHEV credits where applicable: CO $5,000 income-conditioned EV credit; NY Drive Clean $500; MA MOR-EV $1,500 for PHEV; NJ ZEV sales-tax exempt does not apply to PHEV. Source: [PlugStar incentives](https://plugstar.com/incentives).
tcoSource: MY2025 PHEV-specific KBB cost-to-own page not published; substituted with MY2026 sibling (closest analog, similar MSRP and powertrain). KBB 2026 Ford Escape Plug-in Hybrid Cost to Own ( https://www.kbb.com/ford/escape-plug-in-hybrid/2026/cost-to-own/ ): 5-yr total $51,251, depreciation $19,658, OOP $31,593, maintenance ~$5,944 / 5yr. Component split (fuel / insurance / repairs / financing / taxes-fees) inferred from Edmunds 2024 base Escape TCO breakdown ( https://www.edmunds.com/ford/escape/2024/cost-to-own/ : dep $16,201, taxes $2,048, financing $5,142, fuel $8,096, insurance $5,892, repairs $839, maintenance $4,388) and CarEdge component-level data ( https://caredge.com/ford/escape/costs ), adjusted: financing scaled to 2025 PHEV MSRP $39,895; fuel reduced for 37-mi EV range + 40 MPGe hybrid mode; insurance and taxes-fees scaled higher for hybrid/PHEV class. Federal $3,750 PHEV tax credit not netted into these numbers (KBB convention). Edmunds 2025 PHEV stub: https://www.edmunds.com/ford/escape/2025/plug-in-hybrid/ .

subscriptionFeatures: BlueCruise: $495/yr or $49.99/mo or $2,495 one-time at purchase (covers ~7 years). FordPass Connect modem data plan with limited free trial then subscription via AT&T or Verizon. SiriusXM with 360L trial. Source: [Ford BlueCruise pricing](https://media.lincoln.com/content/fordmedia/fna/us/en/news/2024/10/01/ford-lowers-bluecruise-annual--monthly-plan-pricing.html).
drmNotes: Core driving and basic infotainment (radio, Bluetooth, wired CarPlay/AA, USB media) function fully offline. Connected services (FordPass remote start, OTA updates, real-time traffic, FordPass Charging routing) require active modem. OTA updates have changed range estimates, acceleration tuning, and BlueCruise behavior post-sale (mostly additive). No documented remote feature removal. Source: [Ford Authority OTA history](https://fordauthority.com/2024/06/ford-bluecruise-1-3/).
killSwitchNotes: No discrete impaired-driving kill switch in MY2025. BlueCruise uses an IR driver-facing camera to verify driver attention during hands-free operation; outside BlueCruise, the camera is inactive for control purposes. Source: [Ford BlueCruise FAQ](https://www.ford.com/support/how-tos/ford-technology/driver-assist-features/ford-bluecruise-frequently-asked-questions/).
knownIssues: Consumer Reports flags below-average predicted reliability for Mach-E line: infotainment freezes, intermittent 12V battery drains, climate control glitches, occasional charge-port latch failures. Some early MY2025s required SYNC reflash. Source: [Consumer Reports Mach-E](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/ford/mustang-mach-e/).
recalls: NHTSA has issued recalls on prior MY Mach-E units (rearview camera image loss, contactor overheating); MY2025 has been subject to ongoing NHTSA monitoring as part of three open BlueCruise investigations. Source: [NHTSA Recalls](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls).
stateIncentives: Varies. CO: $5,000 state EV credit (income-conditioned). CA CVRP closed. NY: Drive Clean rebate $500-$2,000 depending on range. MA MOR-EV: $3,500. NJ ZEV sales tax exemption. Source: [PlugStar incentives](https://plugstar.com/incentives).

subscriptionFeatures: BlueCruise ($495/yr or $2,495 one-time), FordPass Connect, SiriusXM. Source: [Ford BlueCruise pricing](https://media.lincoln.com/content/fordmedia/fna/us/en/news/2024/10/01/ford-lowers-bluecruise-annual--monthly-plan-pricing.html).
drmNotes: Core driving and infotainment work offline. OTA updates remain Ford-controlled. Source: Ford.com.
killSwitchNotes: BlueCruise IR driver monitoring active only during hands-free in MY2026; no separate impaired-driving kill switch. Federal IIJA mandate compliance target not yet implemented at trim level. Source: [Ford BlueCruise FAQ](https://www.ford.com/support/how-tos/ford-technology/driver-assist-features/ford-bluecruise-frequently-asked-questions/).
knownIssues: Same Mach-E line reliability flags. Source: [Consumer Reports](https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/ford/mustang-mach-e/).
recalls: Subject to Mach-E line recalls and three open NHTSA BlueCruise investigations as of Apr 2026. Source: [Ford Authority NHTSA probes](https://fordauthority.com/2026/04/nhtsa-currently-has-three-ford-bluecruise-investigations-underway/).
tcoSource: Composite: KBB 2026 Mach-E Select Cost to Own (depreciation, maintenance, headline total $58,301 = depreciation $23,356 + out-of-pocket $36,688) + Edmunds 2025 Mach-E True Cost to Own (fuel, insurance, repairs) + MSRP-proportional financing & taxes/fees scaled from 2025 Premium ($39,995) to 2026 Select ($37,795), 15,000 mi/yr, 5-year totals. Sources: https://www.kbb.com/ford/mustang-mach-e/2026/cost-to-own/, https://www.kbb.com/ford/mustang-mach-e/2026/select/, https://www.edmunds.com/ford/mustang-mach-e/2025/cost-to-own/. Anomaly: KBB's standalone 2026 insurance figure ($15,975/yr) is ~3× Edmunds and CarEdge — treated as outlier and replaced with Edmunds-derived $4,100/5yr.
